programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgement...
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.desc: Eagles and Beagles: Dr Oakley meets a dog with a badly infected paw, as the team takes part in a golden eagles research project and help a cat who has eaten its own tail. (S11, ep 10) 7+

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Death of a Dream: Lioness Tsebe holds the Northern Brothers at bay until they prove worthy to father her new dynasty. (S4, ep 3)

programme.title: Cruise TV With LoveitBookit
programme.desc: Your one-stop-shop for all things cruise; bringing you the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals to ensure your next cruise is your greatest one!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: More Than a Feline: A bona fide bevy of bovine awaits Dr Pol and Dr Nicole as they roll out to Clay Knob Farm for herd health checks. (S9, ep 4)

programme.title: National Parks USA: Olympic
programme.desc: Olympic: Along Washington State's rugged coast, Olympic National Park protects one million acres of diverse habitat and houses a rich biodiversity. 7+ (4 of 5)

programme.title: Monster Fish
programme.desc: River Jaws: The search is on for some of Australia's most dangerous river shark species, including the huge and mighty bull shark and the rarely-spotted speartooth. 7+ (S6, ep 1)

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Line of Fire: As Mombo burns, lioness Thata risks everything to save her pride, but it comes at a terrible price. (S4, ep 4)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Squeal of Dreams: Spring is in full swing and that means birthing season for the clinic. Dr Pol gets a request from the local baseball team that comes right out of left field. (S4, ep 18)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Stay Wild: Deep in the Costa Rican rainforest, Dr Oakley and the team track a tapir, help a pregnant sloth, release animals back into the wild and treat a Caracara. (S11, ep 16)

programme.title: Hunt For The Giant Squid
programme.desc: A British team search for a huge 12-metre, 200kg squid. It's a super-sized sea serpent that may have terrorised sailors for centuries, but finding and filming it will be no easy task. 7+

programme.title: Shark Men
programme.desc: Out For Blood: The expedition team in Guadalupe spend the final day attempting their biggest coup yet: to produce a blood sample from a great white female. 7+ (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Not all lions in the Savage Kingdom are born equal while the Marsh Pride dominates the beating heart of the realm.

programme.title: To Catch A Smuggler
programme.desc: Meth Lab Takedown: HSI tails a truck loaded with narcotics to a meth compound, and CBP discovers fentanyl and meth in cars using trusted traveller lanes. 7+ (S3, ep 6)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Just Another Manic Meatball: The Oakleys head back to the Yukon on the longest day of the year, and there's plenty of work at Dev's farm to fill the day! (S11, ep 8) 7+

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Tampa
programme.desc: Wolfpack Miracle: The monumental birth of four endangered Red Wolf pups marks a historic moment for the zoo, but then an injury puts one of the pups' lives in jeopardy. (S3, ep 10) 7+

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Galapagos: Seven hundred miles off the coast of Ecuador lies a collection of islands that harbour some of the strangest creatures to ever exist. These are the Galapagos Islands. 7+ S1 ep1

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Borneo & Sumatra: These two islands harbour some of the most unique yet elusive species on Earth, from pygmy elephants to giant trees and flying lizards to swinging red apes. 7+ (S1, ep 2)
